primer-command.instruction: Patch src/primer/primerCommand.ts in one place: add `import { recordSection } from "../primerRecord/recordSection.js";` and make markdown = renderPrimer(<the same digest>, PRIMER_CAP) + recordSection(root, files, profile, ownership.paths.map((p) => p.path)). Every other line of the file stays as it is.

record-gaps.instruction: Write src/primerRecord/recordGaps.ts, a new file. Imports: `import type { ContourMap, ContourRecord } from "../contour/types.js"`, `import type { LanguageProfile } from "../language/types.js"`, resolveProfile from "../language/profiles.js", cutTargets and slugName from "../language/naming.js", codeTargets, hasExtension, isTest and normalizePath from "../language/paths.js"; nothing else. Export exactly: the interfaces NotBuilt {component: string; function: string; reason: string}, ComponentWeight {component: string; bytes: number}, RecordInputs and RecordGaps with the fields of the Data Objects Record Inputs and Record Gaps (notBuilt: NotBuilt[], weights: ComponentWeight[]), and the functions recordGaps, codeFiles and componentWeights. A map card in ContourMap is an element of map.cards (an array of {id, targets, ...}); a map group is an element of map.groups ({name, functions}). UTF-8 byte length: Buffer.byteLength(line, "utf8").

import-gaps.instruction: Write src/primerRecord/importGaps.ts, a new file. Its only import: `import { posix } from "node:path"`. Export exactly the interfaces CodeText {path: string; text: string} and LayerGap {from: string; to: string; file: string} and the function importGaps(language: string, module: string, files: readonly CodeText[], edges: Record<string, string[]>): LayerGap[]. "An own key of edges" is Object.hasOwn(edges, key).

render-record.instruction: Write src/primerRecord/renderRecord.ts, a new file. Its only imports: `import type { RecordGaps } from "./recordGaps.js"` and `import type { LayerGap } from "./importGaps.js"` (another card writes those files: RecordGaps is {components: number; functions: number; notBuilt: {component: string; function: string; reason: string}[]; notRecorded: string[]; weights: {component: string; bytes: number}[]; warnings: string[]}, LayerGap is {from: string; to: string; file: string}). Export exactly: `export type RecordSection = { state: "not read"; reason: string } | { state: "read"; gaps: RecordGaps; layers: { checked: false; reason: string } | { checked: true; gaps: LayerGap[] } }`, `export const RECORD_CAP = 10`, `export const WEIGHT_RULE = 30000` and renderRecord. tests/fixtures/primerRecord/section1.md in your context is the exact output for a section read with every list; it begins with an empty line.

record-section.instruction: Write src/primerRecord/recordSection.ts, a new file. Imports: readFileSync and statSync from "node:fs"; join and posix from "node:path"; loadContour and loadMap from "../contour/load.js"; `layerEdges(record: ContourRecord, map: ContourMap): { ok: true; edges: Record<string, string[]> } | { ok: false; errors: string[] }` from "../rules/layers.js"; `guardContract(guard: string): number` from "../rules/guardrails.js"; `import type { LanguageProfile } from "../language/types.js"`; recordGaps and codeFiles from "./recordGaps.js"; importGaps and `type CodeText` from "./importGaps.js"; renderRecord and `type RecordSection` from "./renderRecord.js". Export exactly recordSection(root: string, files: readonly string[], profile: LanguageProfile, owned: readonly string[]): string. Read a text with statSync(p).isFile() then readFileSync(p, "utf8") inside try/catch (null on any error).
